signature.title: Your signature
signature.intro: Approvals use your saved signature. Only you can replace or remove it.
signature.hint: A PNG or JPEG up to 1 MB. We remove any hidden data from the image before it is stored.
signature.unavailable: Signature upload isn't available in this environment.
signature.crop: Part of the image to keep
signature.removeBody: Approvals will need a new signature.
signature.err.type: Pick a PNG or JPEG image.
signature.err.rateLimited: Too many uploads. Try again shortly.
signature.err.mismatch: The upload didn't match. Try again.
signature.err.failed: We couldn't upload your signature. Nothing was changed. Try again.
signature.err.unreadable: We couldn't read that file. Pick it again.
